scope: Rebase and Cherry Pick failed-Pick recovery compatibility with Git 2.39.5
cause: Git 2.39.5 reschedules a negative Pick failure into git-rebase-todo while also retaining stopped-sha through error_with_patch/make_patch.

Prior classification gave stopped-sha precedence, treating a rescheduled signing failure as applied and replaying the same Pick after committing it; a pre-apply obstruction was mistaken for a became-empty stop.
The older save_todo implementation can also append the preceding command to done again when rescheduling a later Pick, affecting occurrence and updateRefs progress bookkeeping.

behaviors: Identify a rescheduled occurrence using the complete owned remaining plan and checked done prefix before considering stopped-sha.
Distinguish deliberate repeated commit hashes from a rescheduled occurrence.
Recognize only the witnessed legacy duplicate preceding done command and normalize it within the existing recoverable journal transaction.
Retain same-item Retry, approved Skip cleanup, reference-update bookkeeping, became-empty handling and cancellation/changed-state fences.
